# Sample Restaurant v0.05

Restaurant v0.05 is a conversion-focused content engine with a sticky Menu/Reserve/Event CTA, menu.json discovery, deep schema, testimonials, accessibility, and an A/B dark preview.

## Key routes
- /menu rich HTML menu
- /menu?variant=dark A/B dark preview
- /menu.json full structured menu for agents
- /schema.json Restaurant/Menu/MenuSection/MenuItem/Offer/Review schema
- /items/101 item page by ID
- /menu/starters/seared-scallops clean item route

## Future hook
The Menu/Reserve/Event CTA is reserved for a future chat entry point backed by the business D1 knowledge base.

## Guardrails
Preview only. No production routes. No custom domains. No account IDs. No secrets.
